outcome_scoring_v1.what_it_does: Scores every AIDY decision against its real baseline (provider_trade_scores, reused not re-derived). approve/continue always equals the baseline (delta=0, no manufactured credit). deny/conflict_deny/hold is scored as if never taken (0 pnl), so delta = negative of the real trade's actual pnl -- a denied trade that really lost reads confirmed_helped, one that really won reads confirmed_hurt, purely from the sign of an already-computed number, never invented.
outcome_scoring_v1.new_table: aidy_decision_outcomes (append-only, write-once per decision -- no re-scoring, ever)
